notes_for_editor: No Lighthouse Board reports before 1891 are in the corpus, so the 1826 and 1858 construction history rests on the NRHP nomination, NPS, FILPS and Lighthousefriends (the last two secondary; own words used). Many anecdotes (Dominy, Mott, Oberly, Miller, ducks) are Lighthousefriends-only and carry no primary check; Oberly is a charge, not a verdict. The Oregon wreck date (not in my sources) is left out of the story. Roster is the USLHS archive's full 191 lines matched by script; Mott's other stations come from Lighthousefriends only (years approximate). NPS and FILPS disagree on when the first lens left (1933 vs 1939 for Franklin Institute display), and on banding (1891 vs 1892). Current tower access is time-sensitive (closed March 2023 per Lighthousefriends). Newspaper searches for Oberly (1921) and Oregon (1886) timed out against the loc.gov rate limit. Light characteristic, range and the present optic are not given in the sources I read (record says Fl W 7.5s, 24 nm); not asserted.
